import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import os

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Prepare features and target
target = "Cover_Type"
features = [col for col in train_df.columns if col != "Id" and col != target]

X = train_df[features]
y = train_df[target]
X_test = test_df[features]

# Split data for genuine validation (90% train, 10% val)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Define LightGBM parameters
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": 7,
    "metric": "multi_error",
    "verbose": -1,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "n_estimators": 500,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "device": "cpu",
}

# Train model
print("Training model...")
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params, random_state=42)
model.fit(
    X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], early_stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False
)

# Evaluate on validation set
val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
val_acc = accuracy_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_acc}")

# Predict on test set
print("Predicting on test set...")
test_preds = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_preds})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
